Method of Attack: wormable pre-auth remote code execution vulnerability in SMBv3
exploitation by sending specially crafted packets to SMBv3 server
allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code
wormable attack enabling easy spread from victim to victim
Attack Vector: sending specially crafted compressed data packets to SMBv3 server
Discoverer: Microsoft Active Protections Program security vendors
Indicators of Compromise: PowerShell command to disable SMBv3 compression: Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters" DisableCompression -Type DWORD -Value 1 -Force
